objective: Separate competitor workflow misspecification from attainable performance under matched demography.

evaluation_data.source: Archived campaign configurations generated before this comparison
evaluation_data.technical_validation: Before creating any method arm, deterministically remove each VCF row containing a GT allele other than 0 or 1. Retain the raw frozen VCFs and record the raw and validated hashes plus every removed coordinate.
evaluation_data.reuse_rule: All arms within a scenario use byte-identical validated VCF, truth-map NPZ, tree-sequence, and genome files.

ReLERNN.compatibility_patch_scope: Save and reload only the trained weights for ReLERNN's fixed GRU architecture, avoiding Keras 3 whole-model serialization failures while leaving simulation, architecture, optimization, evaluation, and prediction unchanged.
ReLERNN.runtime_reason: NVIDIA's Blackwell-optimized TensorFlow image is required for Betty B200 GPUs; every paired arm uses the same image.
ReLERNN.rate_prior_rule: ceil(1.15 * length-weighted truth-map rate quantile 0.999 / mutation rate), held equal between demographic arms of a scenario

pyrho.isolation_rule: Only the population-size history supplied to make_table changes within a scenario.

endpoints.primary: Pooled Pearson correlation with the exact map at 25 kb
secondary: Median estimated-to-true rate ratio at 25 and 100 kb

analysis_rules: Report every completed arm; do not select runs by Arabis or manuscript-favorable outcomes.
Do not tune epochs, map scale, rate-prior rule, pyrho window, or block penalty after viewing results.
Permit only technical fixes that preserve the frozen data, histories, seeds, and endpoints.
Use Betty Slurm allocations for all Betty computation.
